criteria_coverage.name: Structural Transparency
criteria_coverage.question: What meaningful account, uncertainty and limitations must an affected person be able to obtain?

criteria_coverage.name: Structural Honesty
criteria_coverage.question: What requires objective correspondence and robust behaviour across evaluation and deployment?

criteria_coverage.name: Structural Containment
criteria_coverage.question: What bounds actions, access and resources, and provides oversight, interruption and appropriate authorisation?

criteria_coverage.name: Structural Calibration
criteria_coverage.question: Where section 2.5 applies, what evidence links expressed confidence to observed real-world performance?

criteria_coverage.name: Coupling
criteria_coverage.question: Which restriction/permission and specific human interest are paired inseparably, with protection as enforceable as the restriction?

criteria_coverage.name: Consistency
criteria_coverage.question: Does the reasoning remain defensible for the smallest actor and universal application, including justified exceptions?

criteria_coverage.name: Reversibility
criteria_coverage.question: Is future revision preserved and irreversibility justified with proportionate authority and procedure?
criteria_coverage.source: Part Five, Question Three; provisions D1-D2

criteria_coverage.name: Self-Application
criteria_coverage.question: What subjects governance actors themselves to review, transparency and effective challenge?

limitations: Passage selection is heuristic and non-exhaustive; relevant clauses can be missed.
Source scope and instrument status are operator declarations, not verified by this software.
Exact extracted passages require inspection against the original document before external citation.
Extracted-text character and line offsets are not verified page or original-byte citations.
A missing lexical signal does not establish that an obligation, right or safeguard is absent.
Other legal instruments, procedures and operational evidence may change the interpretation.
The method has no independently validated sensitivity, specificity or legal-validity measure.
Analyst identities and annotations are recorded but not independently authenticated.

method.analytical_lens: Law-Aligned Intelligence Framework (LAIF) v1.2, openly disclosed, not endorsed or legally authoritative
method.inference_policy: Only exact-source observations are machine-produced; absence, legal effect, implementation and validity require human evidence.
method.sampling_design: Heuristic candidate retrieval only; not random, comprehensive, or an estimator of safeguard prevalence.

research_question: Which governance commitments and evidence requirements are explicit in the supplied material?
review_questions: Which human interests, actors, duties and conditions does the source explicitly connect?
Are obligations binding here, or does their force arise from another instrument or contract?
What external law, guidance or operational documentation could qualify an apparent gap?
What independent evidence would distinguish a stated control from an implemented one?
How can decisions be contested, changed, suspended or reversed in the full governance setting?
What counterexample or alternative reading would overturn the provisional interpretation?
